name: universal-workbench
description: Route research and project work across Context Window Manager, Deep Research Engine, and Universal Reach.

interface.longDescription: A routing layer for Context Window Manager, Deep Research Engine, and Universal Reach. It selects platforms and sources, carries scope and evidence between workflows, and coordinates Figma and engineering tasks. Broad research uses the Deep Research Engine skill with host retrieval tools; Universal Reach adds relevant platform evidence; Context Window Manager handles project continuity. It depends on those capabilities but routes to each only when needed; it does not replace or bundle them.
defaultPrompt: Use Deep Research Engine for broad sourced research, Universal Reach when platform or community evidence matters, and Context Window Manager for project continuity.
Recover my project context and route the next work across my companion plugins.
Implement this Figma design in my codebase.
